log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 3 gate (packet )

body.p: For the owner. Every gate box is ticked ().

item.p: 0.2.0 and XQuery. 0.2.0 is still untagged; CHANGELOG.md lists XQuery under "Unreleased". Tag 0.2.0 at the Phase 2 commit, or fold XQuery into 0.2.0.

WebAssembly budgets (Proposed): sxml.wasm is 1,900,448 bytes stripped and 659,284 gzipped against 2,000,000 / 700,000 (5 % left); the CLI with XQuery and XSLT 4,624,576 / 1,032,045 against 5,000,000 / 1,100,000. compileQuery() is still not in the JavaScript package. Confirm the budgets, or ask for optional modules.
XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default (Proposed, ): no (write the declaration, as QT4 expects) or keep yes. The only behaviour of the now stable xquery.h still open.
CI (): still local only; macOS, Windows and MSVC unbuilt since the Phase 0 gate.
